question: Which ATT&CK techniques does CAPEC-652 (Use of Known Kerberos Credentials) map to, and what mitigations apply to those techniques?

answer.headline: Gathered 2 record(s) from 2 source(s); 1 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: CAPEC-652 (Use of Known Kerberos Credentials) maps to the ATT&CK technique T1558 (Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets). The mitigations for T1558 include M1041 (Encrypt Sensitive Information), M1015 (Active Directory Configuration), M1047 (Audit), M1026 (Privileged Account Management), M1027 (Password Policies), and M1043 (Credential Access Protection).

records.name: Use of Known Kerberos Credentials
records.label: AttackPattern
records.description: An adversary obtains (i.e. steals or purchases) legitimate Kerberos credentials (e.g. Kerberos service account userID/password or Kerberos Tickets) with the goal of achieving authenticated access to additional systems, applications, or services within the domain.

results.sub_question: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for those mapped techniques?
results.query: MATCH (t:Technique) WHERE t.attack_id IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[:MITIGATES]-(m:Mitigation) RETURN t.attack_id AS technique_id, t.name AS technique_name, m.attack_id AS mitigation_id, m.name AS mitigation_name LIMIT 300
